g.text: Seller Application Submission and Administrator Review
shop, identity and bank document fields
find user, user's applications and seller record
verified ADMIN role for review routes
load application, admin and existing seller
reject already APPROVED or existing seller
Review authorization is enforced by the filter and proxy.
Approval is not restricted to PENDING, except already APPROVED is blocked.
Reject/request-docs have no current-status guard and do not reverse a Seller record.
No endpoint edits/resubmits an existing application; eligible customers can submit
a new application after REJECTED/NEED_MORE_DOC if no PENDING/APPROVED exists.
